description: Supervisor / planner agent — reads a task, picks tools from a bounded YAML-declared set, and fans out execution across per-tool Dagster assets. Ends with a synthesizer LLM that grounds the final answer in tool outputs. The 'agent of agents' pattern with full lineage.

outputs.description: Emits (2 + N_tools) assets: plan, one per tool, and synthesis.

synthesis_asset_name.label: Synthesis Asset Name
synthesis_asset_name.description: Name of the final synthesis asset.

task.label: Task
task.description: The task / question the supervisor plans against.

model.label: Model
model.description: Optional per-tool model override. When None (default), the component-level `model` is used for this tool. Set this to use a search-capable model (e.g., 'perplexity/sonar-pro' via Vercel AI Gateway) for tools that need real web / retrieval, while keeping cheap models for arithmetic-style tools.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Per-tool API key env var override (defaults to component-level).

api_base_env_var.label: API Base Env Var
api_base_env_var.description: Per-tool base URL env var override — e.g., set to `VERCEL_AI_GATEWAY_URL` for a search-capable route. Defaults to component-level.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.

max_picks.label: Max Picks
max_picks.description: Upper bound on how many tools the planner may pick in one shot. The prompt tells the LLM 'pick minimum 1, maximum N'. Increase for larger tool sets.

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
